# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God's Fatherly Discipline and the Coming Anointed

---

**9:1** When Israel was led away captive into a foreign land —
when they were scattered from Jerusalem to east and west —

**9:2** they praised God with humble hearts, singing to his name;
they declared his mighty acts in the synagogues of the diaspora.

**9:3** Our God is great and glorious,
dwelling in the highest heaven.

**9:4** He set the lights of heaven in their tracks to mark the seasons
year after year;

**9:5** and they have not swerved from the course he assigned them
throughout their entire journey.

**9:6** Their way is in the fear of God every day,
from the day of their creation and forever.

**9:7** They have never strayed since the day he made them;
they have never deviated from the ancient way —
unless God himself commanded a new course.

**9:8** The ways of men are open before him at all times;
he knows the secrets of the heart before a single thought takes shape.

**9:9** Therefore his correction falls on us as a father corrects a firstborn son —
to turn the obedient soul back from a sin it did not know it had done.

**9:10** May God purify Israel for the day of mercy and blessing,
for the day of his choosing when he brings back his anointed.

**9:11** Blessed are those who live to see those days
and witness the good things the LORD does for the coming generation —
under the discipline of the LORD's anointed.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance. Sense-for-sense.*
